==Notes==
*This does not show up in the [[effects monitor]].
*This is an invisible, passive effect applied after resurrection by the Resurrection Shrine.
*While under this effect, [[condition]]s inflicted and [[hex spell]]s cast on you will not be applied on you, and you cannot [[Health loss|lose health]].

==Trivia==
*The [[skill icon]] is just a generic skill icon with the word "Untouchable" superimposed.
